say:1:1741111001:1.text: What I'll do next? I'll think about that later.
say:1:1741111001:1.source_cn: 以后？以后的安排就留给以后想呗。
say:1:1741111001:1.male: What I'll do next? I'll think about that later.
say:1:1741111001:1.female: What I'll do next? I'll think about that later.

say:2:1741111002:1.text: Right now, I'm going to eat, get some sun, then go back to Consortium HQ for a long, nice nap.
say:2:1741111002:1.source_cn: 本狐今日的安排，就是吃饱喝足后晒会儿日光浴，再去秘银总...
say:2:1741111002:1.male: Right now, I'm going to eat, get some sun, then go back to Consortium HQ for a long, nice nap.
say:2:1741111002:1.female: Right now, I'm going to eat, get some sun, then go back to Consortium HQ for a long, nice nap.

say:3:1741111003:1.text: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.
say:3:1741111003:1.source_cn: 跟着你为了圣古堂的事忙活了这一阵子，我都有点想念玩具堆...
say:3:1741111003:1.male: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.
say:3:1741111003:1.female: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.

choice_prompt:4:1741111003.text: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.
choice_prompt:4:1741111003.source_cn: 跟着你为了圣古堂的事忙活了这一阵子，我都有点想念玩具堆那柔软的触感了！
choice_prompt:4:1741111003.male: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.
choice_prompt:4:1741111003.female: All this Hall of Ancients business has worn me out. I miss my soft pile of toys—they're much better company than all this trouble.

say:5:1741111004:1.text: Stop right there! What king? There's no king here. Just a little fox. A completely ordinary little fox!
say:5:1741111004:1.source_cn: 停停停！打住！这里哪有罗兰大帝？站在你面前的只是一只普...
say:5:1741111004:1.male: Stop right there! What king? There's no king here. Just a little fox. A completely ordinary little fox!
say:5:1741111004:1.female: Stop right there! What king? There's no king here. Just a little fox. A completely ordinary little fox!

say:6:1741111005:1.text: And little foxes don't know anything about duty or work. We eat, we sleep, and that's our whole job!
say:6:1741111005:1.source_cn: 小狐狸哪能懂得什么责任、工作、干活？小狐狸的生活就是吃和睡！
say:6:1741111005:1.male: And little foxes don't know anything about duty or work. We eat, we sleep, and that's our whole job!
say:6:1741111005:1.female: And little foxes don't know anything about duty or work. We eat, we sleep, and that's our whole job!

say:7:1741111006:1.text: Besides, I already stuck my neck out for you and those little troublemakers. I blew my cover and even got roped into hunting for Excalibur—unpaid, by the way!
say:7:1741111006:1.source_cn: 别忘了我为了你和这些不省心的孩子，可是不惜暴露了身份，...
say:7:1741111006:1.male: Besides, I already stuck my neck out for you and those little troublemakers. I blew my cover and even got roped into hunting for Excalibur—unpaid, by the way!
say:7:1741111006:1.female: Besides, I already stuck my neck out for you and those little troublemakers. I blew my cover and even got roped into hunting for Excalibur—unpaid, by the way!

say:8:1741111007:1.text: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!
say:8:1741111007:1.source_cn: 不要妄想破坏我来之不易的闲散生活！
say:8:1741111007:1.male: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!
say:8:1741111007:1.female: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!

choice_prompt:9:1741111007.text: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!
choice_prompt:9:1741111007.source_cn: 不要妄想破坏我来之不易的闲散生活！
choice_prompt:9:1741111007.male: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!
choice_prompt:9:1741111007.female: So don't you dare ruin the good life I fought so hard for!

say:10:1741111008:1.text: Well, what can I say? Greatness is hard to hide.
say:10:1741111008:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，那也是没有办法的事情嘛。
say:10:1741111008:1.male: Well, what can I say? Greatness is hard to hide.
say:10:1741111008:1.female: Well, what can I say? Greatness is hard to hide.

say:11:1741111009:1.text: Even back when I was just an ordinary little fox, I was already winning hearts with my smarts and cuteness.
say:11:1741111009:1.source_cn: 在本狐还只是一只普普通通的小狐狸的时候，就凭借聪慧和可...
say:11:1741111009:1.male: Even back when I was just an ordinary little fox, I was already winning hearts with my smarts and cuteness.
say:11:1741111009:1.female: Even back when I was just an ordinary little fox, I was already winning hearts with my smarts and cuteness.

say:12:1741111010:1.text: When your soul shines so brightly, a little fur isn't going to conceal it...
say:12:1741111010:1.source_cn: 哪怕身躯隐藏在普普通通的狐狸的外表下，灵魂还是会散发出...
say:12:1741111010:1.male: When your soul shines so brightly, a little fur isn't going to conceal it...
say:12:1741111010:1.female: When your soul shines so brightly, a little fur isn't going to conceal it...

say:13:1741111011:1.text: It's a burden, yeah, but I'm used to it by now!
say:13:1741111011:1.source_cn: 这种苦恼，本狐已经习以为常了！
say:13:1741111011:1.male: It's a burden, yeah, but I'm used to it by now!
say:13:1741111011:1.female: It's a burden, yeah, but I'm used to it by now!

say:14:1741111012:1.text: Besides, I have plenty of fox friends to cover for me.
say:14:1741111012:1.source_cn: 而且，本狐也是有不少可以帮忙打掩护的狐狸伙伴的。
say:14:1741111012:1.male: Besides, I have plenty of fox friends to cover for me.
say:14:1741111012:1.female: Besides, I have plenty of fox friends to cover for me.

say:15:1741111013:1.text: Just wait for the yearly Savannah fox gathering. Put me in that crowd, and you won't be able to tell which one is me!
say:15:1741111013:1.source_cn: 不相信的话，你可以等一年一度的赛凡纳狐聚的时候看看，绝...
say:15:1741111013:1.male: Just wait for the yearly Savannah fox gathering. Put me in that crowd, and you won't be able to tell which one is me!
say:15:1741111013:1.female: Just wait for the yearly Savannah fox gathering. Put me in that crowd, and you won't be able to tell which one is me!

choice:9:0:1.text: Now that your cover's blown, you'll have even more fans.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 身份已经暴露，粉丝团又要增加了
choice:9:0:1.male: Now that your cover's blown, you'll have even more fans.
choice:9:0:1.female: Now that your cover's blown, you'll have even more fans.

choice:9:1:2.text: People are going to recognize you everywhere now.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 以后你不管走到哪都会被认出来吧
choice:9:1:2.male: People are going to recognize you everywhere now.
choice:9:1:2.female: People are going to recognize you everywhere now.

choice:4:0:1.text: Is it really okay for a king to be like this?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 罗兰大帝过这样颓废的生活没问题吗？
choice:4:0:1.male: Is it really okay for a king to be like this?
choice:4:0:1.female: Is it really okay for a king to be like this?

choice:4:1:2.text: Shouldn't a king have more important things to do?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 身为罗兰大帝，应该承担更多责任啊
choice:4:1:2.male: Shouldn't a king have more important things to do?
choice:4:1:2.female: Shouldn't a king have more important things to do?
